svg.aria-label: Scan: ScanService walks one area once with FileTreeWalker, on the efficiency cores.; Tree: A tree of Node; small files of a folder merge into one row.; AppModel: Holds the tree and all that follows from it, and counts revision up.; Pages: Only read from AppModel and the services, never from the disk.
